messages.content:
Risk: Intentional risk
Description: The risk occurs due to an expected outcome from pursuing a goal
Concern: None
Policy: Investment Advice

Candidate ontology classes:

  Siblings: non-negotiable security, MiFID regulated security, exempt security
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 12/15 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualIdentifiers/ContextualIdentifier: contextual identifier — sequence of characters uniquely identifying that with which it is associated, within a specified context [found by 11/15 queries]
  Siblings: contextual name, merchant identifier, birth certificate identifier
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualIdentifiers/ContextualIdentificationScheme: contextual identification scheme — identification scheme that applies within one or more contexts [found by 10/15 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/MuniIssuance/SecuritiesUnderwritingIssuanceProcess: securities underwriting issuance process — The process by which debt instruments are offered to the market by a syndicate of underwriters who underwrite the issue. [from restriction: facililtatesRemarketing on RemarketingAgent]
  Siblings: equity demutualization process, debt auction process, registered security issuance process
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIssuance/ConversionTerms: conversion terms — contract terms specifying when and how a security may be converted to another security (usually of the same issuer) [from restriction: hasContractualElement on ConvertibleSecurity]
  Siblings: notification provision, put feature, call feature
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context: context — situation or frame of reference in which something applies, exists, happens, or is used and that helps to illustrate or explain it [from restriction: isApplicableIn on ContextualIdentifier]

axes.rationale: The risk is related to the potential harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation, which fits the description of the risk as an expected outcome from pursuing a goal.
The context in which the risk occurs is crucial for understanding the situation or frame of reference in which the intentional risk is pursued.
